description: QFAI's recommended Renovate policy for a repository that has run `qfai init`.

Automerges every dependency update — major included — once the repository's own CI is green, and treats a `qfai` bump as the one update that is not finished when the version number changes: the package writes an assistant tree (skills, agents and the integration wrappers under `.agents/`, `.claude/`, `.codex/` and `.github/`) into the repository, and that tree is only refreshed by running `qfai init --force`. This preset runs it inside the update branch so the regenerated tree is part of the same pull request.
Extend it alongside `config:recommended` rather than instead of it — this file sets a merge policy and the `qfai` rule, and deliberately nothing else.

Running the regeneration command needs a Renovate whose administrator has allow-listed it (`allowedCommands`), which self-hosted Renovate has and the hosted app does not by default. Where it cannot run, this preset fails CLOSED: a `qfai` bump is the one update it does not automerge, so a stale assistant tree can never reach the default branch unreviewed. Extend `qfai-self-hosted` instead once the command is allow-listed.

The `qfai` package itself. `postUpgradeTasks` runs the newly resolved version's own `init --force` in the update branch, and Renovate commits what it wrote alongside the manifest and lockfile change, so the pull request carries the regenerated assistant tree rather than a version number that has outrun it.

`--force` is what makes the refresh happen at all: a plain `init` is create-only and would leave every existing skill, agent and wrapper at the version they were written by. It rewrites the generated integration READMEs and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` without asking, so keep local edits out of those files — the package documents which ones they are.

`automerge` is false here even though everything else automerges. Whether the regeneration above actually ran is an administrator setting this file cannot see, and a `qfai` bump that merged without it would leave the repository claiming a version whose skills it does not have.
prBodyNotes: **This bump also has to refresh the QFAI assistant tree.** If the diff below contains only the manifest and the lockfile, the regeneration step did not run — run `npx qfai init --force` on this branch, commit the result, and merge the two together. If the regenerated tree is already here, this pull request is complete and only needs a review.
